text:
riley: Skimmed the postmortem. We're good at finding fixes but bad at handing them off. Idea: explicit 'closure owner' role that owns remediation until a small closure checklist is done. Pilot?

marta: Yes please. Too many "infra" owners that mean "someone will do it". Closure owner should be a person.

hugo: Suggest roles: incident_ic (during incident), closure_owner (post-incident, 2w), and escalation_owner (if blocked). Keep closure_owner for 14 days max.

priya: Love that. Also propose a tiny closure checklist we can paste into cards so reviewers know when to mark done.

ben: Agree. Let's make the checklist machine-readable one-liner fields so GH action can validate.

riley: Draft card template (one-liners):
```
closure_owner: @handle
owner_contact: handle@redwood.ai
tier: gold|silver|bronze
ack_window: 4h|24h|72h
closure_due: YYYY-MM-DD
closed_when: (link to PR / deploy)
acceptance: one-line acceptance criteria
recurrence_tag: capacity|routing|cache|ci|3p
notes: short note
```

oncall-bot: NOTE: /incidents webhook can stamp incident id onto remediation cards for traceability.

marta: For tiers, propose definitions: gold = customer-impacting live feature, silver = partial degradation, bronze = minor or internal. Different ack windows as in the template.

hugo: Escalation policy suggestion: owner must either move card or post progress in 48h. If not, auto-assign to escalation_owner; after 7 days escalate to team lead and schedule in next sprint.

priya: Comm cadence suggestion (compact):
- 1h: short note to #product (impact + mitigation)
- 6h: status update if ongoing
- 72h: postmortem draft + closure board link
Also: weekly ops note includes a "closure snapshot" (open vs closed count).

ben: IC rotation tweak: keep incident IC weekly but pick closure_owner separately (not necessarily IC) and rotate closure_owner every 2 weeks among oncall volunteers. That reduces IC burn.

riley: Pilot plan:
- Week 0: add closure card template to postmortem checklist and require closure_owner/contact for new items.
- Weeks 1-2: closure-owner trial (14-day sprintlet) + weekly 20m sync for blockers.
- Weeks 3-6: enable auto-escalation on 48h inactivity and measure closure rate.
- Week 7: retro and decide whether to adopt.

marta: Can we track a simple metric: % remediations closed within 14 days (closure_rate) and avg_days_to_close? Add to ops notes.

hugo: I'll add labels for closure_owner and recurrence_tag. Also will wire a GH Action to remind owners after 48h of no activity.

priya: I'll draft comm templates (1h, 6h, 72h) and share by Tue.

ben: Action items:
- hugo -> GH Action prototype for reminders -> due Fri
- priya -> comm templates -> due Tue
- riley -> update postmortem checklist + assign closure_owner field -> due Mon
- marta -> draft short SLAs for tiers -> due Wed
Pilot length: 6 weeks and measure closure_rate and recurrence trends.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "closure-owner kickoff" in 4 days (participants: riley, marta, hugo, priya, ben).

riley: Thanks all. I'll pin a link to this thread on the postmortem and tag the action items. Ping me if you want to co-run the first sync.

marta: I'll volunteer to co-run week 1.

oncall-bot: Note: keep card titles consistent: "incident-<id> - short-desc" to help automated joins for metrics.
